title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in VillaTheme Lucky Wheel…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in VillaTheme Lucky Wheel for WooCommerce – Spin a Sale plugin versions up to 1.2.4. This vulnerability is due to improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags, allowing code injection. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3.
